plain_text:
** AGENDA** 
SCHOOL COMMITTEE MEETING SCHEDULED FOR MONDAY, NOVEMBER 2, 2026 
AT CONNORS ELEMENTARY SCHOOL, 400 BARTLETT ST, LEWISTON 
Note:  
*A review of all general session meetings can be located at www.lewistonpublicschools.org or copies can be requested at a cost of 10 
cents per page.   
**This Agenda includes estimated time for each agenda item which is being used only as a guide to keep the meeting on schedule. 
***Video Notice: This meeting is being recorded and can be viewed on the internet from a link at www.lewistonpublicschools.org 
 
1. Call meeting to order on or about 5:30 pm until approximately 8:30. Pledge of Allegiance. 
 
2. School Committee Member Introductions. 
 
3. Consent Agenda: (a) Minutes (b) Personnel 
 
4. Public Input: (Note: Members of the public may address the School Committee for up to 3 minutes on non-agenda 
items now and on agenda items later. Speakers must adhere to our public comment policy (BEDH), which is 
available in the back of the room or on the LPS website. These meetings exist to conduct school committee business. 
The purpose of public comment is to share thoughts on school and educational matters. Committee members and 
school staff will not reply during this time. Comments must be directed to the Chair and be civil. By law, comments 
may not pertain to specific staff or students; comments about individuals must be directed privately to the 
appropriate LPS staff. Student privacy must be maintained. The public comment period is 30 minutes unless 
extended due to unusual circumstances. Priority goes to Lewiston residents and parents, students, or employees of 
LPS. Before starting, please state your name, town/city of residence, and affiliation to LPS. 
 
5. To receive rotating school reports – Lewiston High School, Connors Elementary School and Geiger Elementary 
School. 
 
6. To discuss and potentially vote on the Opioid Grant Application. 
 
7. To review and potentially vote on the 2nd read of the following policies: 
a. BCA-R - School Committee Concern Procedure 
b. BCB -School Committee Member Conflict of Interest  
c. BCC -Nepotism 
d. BDE -School Committee Standing Committees 
e. BDE-R -Standing Committee Operating Procedures 
 
8. Report from School Committee Chair. 
 
9. Report from School Superintendent. 
 
10. Report from the City Council Rep. 
 
11. Updates from School Committee Subcommittees. 
 
12. School Committee Community Announcements.
13. Future agenda items. 
 
14. To enter into executive session to conduct Student A disciplinary hearing [Title 20-A §1001(9) and Title I 
§405(6)(B)]. 
 
15. To possibly vote on item discussed in executive session. 
 
16. To enter into executive session to conduct Student B disciplinary hearing [Title 20-A §1001(9) and Title I 
§405(6)(B)]. 
 
17. To possibly vote on item discussed in executive session. 
 
18. To enter into executive session to conduct Student C disciplinary hearing [Title 20-A §1001(9) and Title I 
§405(6)(B)]. 
 
19. To possibly vote on item discussed in executive session. 
 
20. To enter into executive session to conduct Student D disciplinary hearing [Title 20-A §1001(9) and Title I 
§405(6)(B)]. 
 
21. To possibly vote on item discussed in executive session. 
 
22. To enter into executive session to discuss or consider the condition, acquisition or the use of real or personal property 
permanently attached to real property or interests therein or disposition of publicly held property or economic 
development only if premature disclosures of the information would prejudice the competitive or bargaining position 
of the body or agency accordance with 1 M.R.S.A. 405(6)(C). 
 
23. To possibly vote on item discussed in executive session. 
 
24. To enter into executive session to discuss a personnel matter in accordance with 1 M.R.S.A. §405(6)(A). 
 
25. Adjourn. 
 
 
ADA Notice: This school district will accommodate members of the public with special needs to participate fully in this 
meeting. Please contact Executive Assistant Cheryl Cornelio (795-4100, Ext.4002) if you have such needs.
